This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Youâll work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership to ensure the organization remains compliant, resilient, and prepared for evolving business risks. If youâre analytical, detail-oriented, and enjoy translating complex risk data into practical business recommendations, this role is built for you. job.jdText: Position : Senior Finance Manager / Management AccountantÂ Salary : PHP 90,000 - PHP 110,000 /month Working Hours & Conditions: Observing AU business hours Holidays : Observing AU holidays ROLE OVERVIEW: Our client is an end-to-end B2B SaaS platform delivering specialized workforce management software designed for operational precision across scheduling, compliance, time tracking, invoicing, and payroll. Operating in a high-volume, multi-entity environment undergoing rapid international expansion and strategic acquisitions, the organization is bringing its core finance operations fully in-house to support scalable long-term growth. Working closely with executive leadership, this critical role goes beyond traditional accounting to take complete ownership of financial consolidations, month-end close optimization, SaaS performance metrics, and commercial analysis. We are seeking a proactive leader with a Financial Controller mindset who can independently challenge assumptions, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and bring clear financial visibility to strategic executive decisions.Â RESPONSIBILITIES: Financial Close, Reporting & Multi-Entity Consolidation: Take end-to-end ownership of the month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and consolidated financial reporting. Lead the strategic transition of financial close and reporting activities from external advisers to the internal finance function. Audit and streamline close workflows to significantly reduce month-end closing timelines from 2â3 weeks. Prepare accurate, consolidated profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports across multiple domestic and international entities while maintaining audit-ready documentation. Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis: Deliver monthly management accounts supported by deep, commercially relevant commentary on business performance and profitability drivers. Perform budget-versus-actual and month-on-month variance analyses, actively investigating root causes rather than merely reporting numbers. Develop, maintain, and refine annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and multi-entity cash flow projections. Partner with executive leadership to evaluate operational margins, identify financial risks, and translate complex financial data into actionable growth strategies. SaaS Performance Metrics & Revenue Recognition: Track, analyze, and report on key SaaS metrics, including MRR, ARR, churn, customer retention, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and customer lifetime value (LTV). Reconcile complex subscription, recurring billing, and usage data with core management accounts in full alignment with revenue recognition principles. Acquisitions & Process Transformation: Support post-acquisition financial integrations, harmonizing accounting policies, chart of accounts, and financial frameworks across acquired businesses. Audit existing financial workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and implement modern automation tools and robust internal controls. Coach and uplift existing bookkeeping and operational finance team members, establishing clear procedures, responsibilities, and reporting deadlines. QUALIFICATIONS: Experience: Minimum 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including substantial senior management accounting, finance manager, or financial controller responsibilities. Industry Background: Proven experience operating within a B2B SaaS, subscription-based technology, or recurring revenue software business. Core Technical Competencies: Demonstrated ownership of financial consolidations, multi-entity accounting, month-end close streamlining, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. SaaS Expertise: Deep working knowledge of subscription billing models, revenue recognition standards, and core SaaS unit economics (MRR/ARR/Churn). Education & Skills: Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; advanced Excel skills for complex financial modeling; and exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for senior stakeholder management. DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED): Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent. Direct reporting experience to a CFO, Finance Director, or senior executive. Exposure to Australian accounting standards, tax compliance, and business frameworks. Practical experience navigating fast-paced technology businesses undergoing mergers and acquisitions (M&A) or international expansion. Familiarity with integrated SaaS billing engines, ERP platforms, and automated reporting systems. job.jdText: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503) Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL) Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System Presales experience, including building and delivering demos Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. job.title: Technical Customer Support
job.jdText: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type: full-time or part-time Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). job.jdText: Who We Are Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role. Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion. Working here means: High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it. Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers The Role In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations. Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support. The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â What You'll Do Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following: Financial Operations ManagementÂ Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time. Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly. Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time. Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time. Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed. Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances. Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows. Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows. Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â Who You Are We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings: Required QualificationsÂ Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools. Advanced coding skills are not required. Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment. Â Â Preferred QualificationsÂ CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred. Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â What We Offer This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications. â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar â Three weeks of paid vacation annually â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina. â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job How to Apply To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English.
